probes.tag: stage vs potential 同节点同值率
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN a.development_potential_score = p.potential_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same, SUM(CASE WHEN a.development_potential_score <> p.potential_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diff FROM ads_technology_stage_assessment a JOIN ads_technology_potential_assessment p ON a.technology_node_id = p.technology_node_id AND a.model_version = p.model_version
SELECT model_version, hotspot_status, COUNT(*) c FROM ads_technology_hotspot_snapshot GROUP BY model_version, hotspot_status ORDER BY model_version, c DESC
